robustness_note: If ALL candidates have negative net P&L, no multiple testing correction (WRC, SPA, RW, Holm, BH) can make them positive. The qualitative conclusion (no survivors) is robust to the missing statistics. Statistics would only matter if some candidates were positive and we needed to determine which survive multiplicity.
